verses.en: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
verses.pt: Ora, os príncipes do povo habitaram em Jerusalém; e o restante do povo lançou sortes, para atirar um de cada dez que habitasse na santa cidade de Jerusalém, ficando nove nas outras cidades.
verses.en_web: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
verses.en_bbe: And the rulers of the people were living in Jerusalem: the rest of the people made selection, by the decision of chance, of one out of every ten to be living in Jerusalem, the holy town; the other nine to go to the other towns.

verses.en: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E o povo bendisse todos os homens que voluntariamente se ofereceram para habitar em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And the people gave a blessing to all the men who were freely offering to take up their places in Jerusalem.

verses.en: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
verses.pt: Estes, pois, são os chefes da província que habitaram em Jerusalém; porém nas cidades de Judá habitou cada um na sua possessão, nas suas cidades, a saber, Israel, os sacerdotes, os levitas, os netinins e os filhos dos servos de Salomão.
verses.en_web: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah everyone lived in his possession in their cities: Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the chiefs of the divisions of the country who were living in Jerusalem: but in the towns of Judah everyone was living on his heritage in the towns, that is, Israel, the priests, the Levites, the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon's servants.

verses.en: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
verses.pt: E habitaram em Jerusalém alguns dos filhos de Judá e dos filhos de Benjamim. Dos filhos de Judá: Ataías, filho de Uzias, filho de Zacarias, filho de Amarias, filho de Sefatias, filho de Maalelel, dos filhos de Pérez;
verses.en_web: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
verses.en_bbe: And in Jerusalem there were living certain of the children of Judah and of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah, the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

verses.en: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
verses.pt: e Maaséias, filho de Baruque, filho de Col-Hoze, filho de Hazaías, filho de Adaías, filho de Joiaribe, filho de Zacarias, filho de Silôni.
verses.en_web: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
verses.en_bbe: And Maaseiah, the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

verses.en: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.pt: Todos os filhos de Pérez que habitaram em Jerusalém foram quatrocentos e sessenta e oito homens valentes.
verses.en_web: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.
verses.en_bbe: All the sons of Perez living in Jerusalem were four hundred and sixty-eight men of good position.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
verses.pt: São estes os filhos de Benjamim: Salu, filho de Mesulão, filho de Joede, filho de Pedaías, filho de Colaías, filho de Maaséias, filho de Itiel, filho de Jesaías.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

verses.en: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.pt: E depois dele Gabai, Salai, ...novecentos e vinte e oito.
verses.en_web: After him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
verses.en_bbe: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight.

verses.en: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
verses.pt: Joel, filho de Zicri, superintendente sobre eles; e Judá, filho de Senua, o segundo sobre a cidade.
verses.en_web: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.
verses.en_bbe: And Joel, the son of Zichri, was their overseer; and Judah, the son of Hassenuah, was second over the town.

verses.en: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
verses.pt: Dos sacerdotes: Jedaías, filho de Joiaribe, Jaquim,
verses.en_web: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
verses.en_bbe: Of the priests: Jedaiah, the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

verses.en: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
verses.pt: Seraías, filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Altube, príncipe sobre a casa de Deus;
verses.en_web: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,
verses.en_bbe: Seraiah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God,

verses.en: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
verses.pt: e seus irmãos que faziam a obra da casa, oitocentos e vinte e dois; e Adaías, filho de Jeroão, filho de Pelalias, filho de Anzi, filho de Zacarias, filha de Pasur, filho de Malquias,
verses.en_web: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
verses.en_bbe: And their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred and twenty-two; and Adaiah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

verses.en: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.pt: e seus irmãos, cabeças de casas paternas, duzentos e quarenta e dois; e Amassai, filho de Azarel, filho de Aazai, filho de Mesilemote, filho de Imer,
verses.en_web: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.en_bbe: And his brothers, heads of families, two hundred and forty-two; and Amashsai, the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

verses.en: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
verses.pt: e os irmãos deles, homens valentes, cento e vinte e oito; e o superintendente sobre eles era Zabdiel, filho de Hagedolim.
verses.en_web: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
verses.en_bbe: And their brothers, men of war, a hundred and twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

verses.en: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.pt: Dos levitas: Semaías, filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, filho de Buni;
verses.en_web: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.en_bbe: And of the Levites: Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni,

verses.en: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
verses.pt: Sabetai e Jozabade, dos cabeças dos levitas, presidiam o serviço externo da casa de Deus;
verses.en_web: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;
verses.en_bbe: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who were responsible for the outside business of the house of God;

verses.en: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.pt: Matanias, filho de Mica, filho de Zabdi, filho de Asafe, o dirigente que iniciava as ações de graças na oração, e Baquebuquias, o segundo entre seus irmãos; depois Abda, filho de Samua, filho de Galal, filho de Jedútun.
verses.en_web: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.en_bbe: And Mattaniah, the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who had to give the first note of the song of praise in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers, and Abda, the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

verses.en: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.pt: Todos os levitas na santa cidade foram duzentos e oitenta e quatro.
verses.en_web: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
verses.en_bbe: All the Levites in the holy town were two hundred and eighty-four.

verses.en: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
verses.pt: Também os porteiros, Acube, Talmom, e seus irmãos, os guardas das portas, foram cento e sessenta e dois.
verses.en_web: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.
verses.en_bbe: In addition the door-keepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers who kept watch at the doors, were a hundred and seventy-two.

verses.en: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.pt: O resto de Israel e dos sacerdotes e levitas, habitou em todas as cidades de Judá, cada um na sua herança.
verses.en_web: The residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: And the rest of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, every one in his heritage.

verses.en: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
verses.pt: Os netinins, porém, habitaram em Ofel; e Ziá e Gispa presidiram sobre eles.
verses.en_web: But the temple servants lived in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.
verses.en_bbe: But the Nethinim were living in the Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.

verses.en: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
verses.pt: O superintendente dos levitas em Jerusalém era Uzi, filho de Bani, filho de Hasabias, filho de Matanias, filho de Mica, dos filhos de Asafe, os cantores; ele estava encarregado do serviço da casa de Deus.
verses.en_web: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of God’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And the overseer of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi, the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the music-makers, who was over the business of the house of God.

verses.en: For it was the king’s commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
verses.pt: Pois havia uma ordem da parte do rei acerca deles, e uma norma para os cantores, estabelecendo o dever de cada dia.
verses.en_web: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.
verses.en_bbe: For there was an order from the king about them and a regular amount for the music-makers, for their needs day by day.

verses.en: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.pt: E Petaías, filho de Mesezabel, dos filhos de Zerá, filho de Judá, estava às ordens do rei, em todos os negócios concernentes ao povo.
verses.en_web: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.en_bbe: And Pethahiah, the son of Meshezabel, of the sons of Zerah, the son of Judah, was the king's servant in everything to do with the people.

verses.en: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
verses.pt: E quanto às aldeias com os seus campos, alguns dos filhos de Judá habitaram em Quiriate-Arba e seus arrabaldes, em Dibom e seus arrabaldes, e em Jecabzeel e suas aldeias;
verses.en_web: As for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,
verses.en_bbe: And for the daughter-towns with their fields, some of the men of Judah were living in Kiriath-arba and its daughter-towns, and in Dibon and its daughter-towns, and in Jekabzeel and its daughter-towns,

verses.en: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,
verses.pt: em Jesuá, em Molada, em Bete-Pelete,
verses.en_web: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,
verses.en_bbe: And in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and Beth-pelet,

verses.en: And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and in the villages thereof,
verses.pt: Em Hazar-Sual, em Berseba e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,
verses.en_bbe: And in Hazar-shual, and in Beer-sheba and its daughter-towns,

verses.en: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
verses.pt: em Ziclague, em Mecona e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,
verses.en_bbe: And in Ziklag, and in Meconah and its daughter-towns,

verses.en: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
verses.pt: em En-Rimom, em Zorá, em Jarmute,
verses.en_web: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
verses.en_bbe: And in En-rimmon, and in Zorah, and in Jarmuth,

verses.en: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
verses.pt: em Zanoa, em Adulão e suas aldeias, em Laquis e seus campos, e em Azeca e seus arrabaldes. Acamparam-se, pois, desde Berseba até o vale do Hinom.
verses.en_web: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.
verses.en_bbe: Zanoah, Adullam and their daughter-towns, Lachish and its fields, Azekah and its daughter-towns. So they were living from Beer-sheba to the valley of Hinnom.

verses.en: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages,
verses.pt: Os filhos de Benjamim também habitaram desde Geba em diante, em Micmás e Aíja, em Betel e seus arrabaldes,
verses.en_web: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Benjamin were living from Geba, at Michmash and Aija, and at Beth-el and its daughter-towns,

verses.en: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
verses.pt: em Anatote, em Nobe, em Ananias,
verses.en_web: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
verses.en_bbe: At Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

verses.en: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
verses.pt: em Hazor, em Ramá, em Gitaim,
verses.en_web: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
verses.en_bbe: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

verses.en: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
verses.pt: em Hadide, em Zeboim, em Nebalate,
verses.en_web: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
verses.en_bbe: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

verses.en: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
verses.pt: em Lode, e em Ono, vale dos artífices.
verses.en_web: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
verses.en_bbe: Lod and Ono, the valley of expert workers.

verses.en: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
verses.pt: E dos levitas que habitavam em Judá, algumas turmas foram unidas a Benjamim.
verses.en_web: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.
verses.en_bbe: And of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah were joined to Benjamin.
